name: First Seal Approach
description: The ancient coastline east of the Salt Coast, where the Wardens built the first of their great seals millennia ago. Weathered pylons and crumbling roads hint at a civilization that poured everything into containing what lies below. The air hums with residual warding energy, and the local wildlife has been warped by centuries of exposure.

The air between the pillars thrums with barely-perceptible energy. Something powerful was contained here — or still is.

rooms.description: A vast semicircular courtyard before the entrance to the Cradle. The pavement is inlaid with a massive warding circle in brass and obsidian, still intact despite the ruin of everything around it. The circle's geometric precision is breathtaking — every line, every angle calculated to contain and redirect enormous amounts of arcane energy. At the far edge, a stairway descends into darkness.

rooms.name: Watcher's Perch
rooms.description: An elevated stone platform at the eastern end of the Pillar Walk, built as a watch post overlooking the approaches from three directions. It is beautiful and terrible in its ruined grandeur. Above, a precarious traverse along the cliff face leads up to the Glass Desert — you can see the shimmering fused landscape on the plateau above.
